intro: Review what you've learned about feedback and speed.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of feedback during software development?

options.text: To collect users' opinions about the software's visual design.
To find ways to improve code performance before deployment.
To determine whether recent changes moved the system closer to solving the intended problem.

questions.prompt: Why does feedback speed matter during software development?

options.text: It lets developers finish features faster, regardless of quality.
Fast cycles remove the need to analyze requirements or adjust designs.
Fast feedback makes sure the product looks appealing before release.
Fast feedback catches errors and misunderstandings before they create more rework.
